correctness.rationale: A positive shortest-edge length makes the complete short-route trichotomy valid. Same-edge squares contribute 2ℓr−r², ordered incident-edge triangular pairs contribute r² per unordered incident pair, and all other pairs contribute zero. Sum and normalize, then invert derivatives. The subdivision/Betti and tree extremal identities follow from handshaking and pair counting. Exact rational route-inequality integration passes 24 examples; the analytical argument, not the finite checks, proves the universal theorem.
